question.text: The convex lens $\left(L_1\right.$ and $\left.L_2\right)$ of equal focal length $f$ are placed at a distance $\frac{f}{2}$ apart. An object is placed at a distance $4 f$ in the left of $L_1$ as shown in figure. The final image is at

solution.text: $\begin{aligned} & \frac{1}{v}-\frac{1}{u}=\frac{1}{f} \\ & \frac{1}{v}-\frac{1}{-4 f}=\frac{1}{f} \Rightarrow \frac{1}{v}=\frac{1}{f}-\frac{1}{4 f} \Rightarrow \frac{1}{v}=\frac{4-1}{4 f} \Rightarrow v=\frac{4 f}{3} \\ & u_2=\frac{4 f}{3}-\frac{f}{2}=\frac{8 f-3 f}{6} \Rightarrow u_2=\frac{5 f}{6} \\ & \frac{1}{v_2}-\frac{1}{u_2}=\frac{1}{f} \Rightarrow \frac{1}{v_2}-\frac{6}{5 f}=\frac{1}{f} \Rightarrow \frac{1}{v_2}=\frac{1}{f}+\frac{6}{5 f} \\ & \frac{1}{v_2}=\frac{11}{5 f} \Rightarrow v_2=\frac{5 f}{11}\end{aligned}$
